Name: (CP) Nightmare's Farmhouse
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]
This version is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/318]Nightmare's Farmhouse [/url]mod created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/23988239]Nightmare[/url].

After a significant hiatus from Nexus, I am now returning to my inbox and emails to resume the projects that were put on hold. Prior to my absence, I had the opportunity to engage in communication with Nightmare, seeking their opinion and obtaining their [url=https://imgur.com/z5JXEpb]permission [/url]for this upload.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HmfUsq0.png[/img]
This mod offers you a variety of farmhouse versions. You can change and configure the mod by accessing the generic config menu from 'mod options' settings.
﻿

[code]EnableMod: A checkbox for enabling/disabling this mod. It will take 1 in-game day to affect the game.
FarmhouseColor: A dropdown object for selecting farmhouse colors. It will take 1 in-game day to affect the game.
[/code]
